request_payload.title: Does long-term phenytoin have a place in Dravet syndrome?

mentions.sentence: We describe four patients with Dravet syndrome in whom long-term phenytoin therapy reduced seizure frequency and duration.

candidates.summary: Germline activating HRAS changes cause Costello syndrome: feeding problems, loose skin, heart disease, developmental delay and a raised tumour risk.
